full_prompt_en: The image is a square, close black-and-white photographic portrait of a woman with her eyes lowered, one side of her face illuminated and the other absorbed by deep shadow. The background is almost entirely black, offering no recognizable room or landscape and leaving the head and bare upper shoulder as the only clear forms. Dark hair curves around the top and left edge, with loose strands touching the forehead and much of the right side merging into the background. Her face tilts downward and slightly toward the right, so the visible cheek, nose, lashes, and lips form a descending diagonal through the center. One closed eyelid carries a narrow soft highlight and long dark lashes. The nose catches brighter light along its bridge and tip, then falls quickly into the shadow beyond. Her lips are gently parted, with a muted sheen on the lower lip and a dark line between them. The jaw remains visible through a smooth gray gradient, while a strong black wedge under the chin separates it from the illuminated neck and shoulder at the bottom left. A small mark on the pale shoulder and a faint thin stray line remain visible instead of being polished away. The opposite side of the face is scarcely defined; its darkness gives the illuminated features a quiet sculptural focus. A soft directional light arrives from the upper left and front, carving smooth planes from near-black to silver-gray rather than flattening the features. Fine grain and tiny tonal irregularities show on the lighter skin, while the surrounding black has very little detail. The crop is intimate, with hair and shoulder cut by the frame and no distracting accessory or readable text. The overall composition is contemplative and stark, using one diagonal fall of light to make a small set of features emerge from darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、近距离的黑白摄影肖像：一名女子垂下双眼，一侧脸受光，另一侧被深影吞没。背景几乎全黑，没有可辨的房间或风景，头部与裸露的上肩成为唯一清楚形体。深发沿顶部和左边弯曲，松散发丝触及额头，右侧大部分则融入背景。她的脸向下并略向右倾，因此可见的面颊、鼻、睫毛与嘴唇在中央形成下降的斜线。一只闭合眼睑带着细窄的柔和亮部和长而深的睫毛。鼻梁与鼻尖接住更亮的光，随后迅速落入旁边的阴影。双唇轻轻分开，下唇有低调光泽，唇间是一道深线。下颌可在平滑灰度渐变中辨认，而颏下强烈的黑色楔形将其与左下受光的脖颈和肩部分开。浅色肩上有一个小痕迹和一条极淡的细线仍然可见，没有被修饰掉。脸的另一侧几乎无法界定；这片暗色使受光五官拥有安静的雕塑感焦点。柔和的方向光从左上前方进入，将平滑平面从近黑刻到银灰，而非把五官照平。较浅的肌肤上可见细颗粒和微小调子变化，周围黑色则几乎没有细节。取景亲密，头发与肩膀被画边裁切，没有分散注意的配件或可读文字。整体构图沉思而强烈，以一道斜落的光让少量面部特征从黑暗中浮出。
style_prompt_en: An intimate monochrome photographic treatment uses directional light to reveal selected smooth planes against extensive near-black. Highlights are narrow and silvery rather than white and flat, and gentle gray transitions model form before dropping abruptly into shadow. Fine grain and minor surface irregularities remain visible in the lit areas. Dark contours may merge with the surrounding field, leaving only partial edges for the eye to complete. A close crop and a descending diagonal organize the image, while generous black negative space concentrates attention on a small illuminated region. Contrast is strong but controlled; soft light gives the transitions a quiet sculptural quality. The overall effect is restrained, tactile, and introspective, with shadow acting as a deliberate part of the composition.
style_prompt_zh: 这种亲密的黑白摄影处理以方向光从大面积近黑中揭示选定的平滑平面。亮部细窄而带银色，并非平白一片；温和灰度过渡先塑造形体，再突然跌入阴影。受光区域保留细颗粒与微小表面变化。深色轮廓可以融入周围色域，只留下部分边缘让视线自行补全。近距离裁切与下降斜线组织图像，丰足黑色留白把注意集中到小块受光区域。反差强却受控；柔光使过渡具有安静的雕塑质感。整体效果克制、可触且内省，阴影是构图的有意组成部分。
theme_en: A close black-and-white study of a woman with closed eyes, half her face in shadow
theme_zh: 一幅黑白近景肖像：女子闭眼，半张脸隐在阴影中
name: Ruth Bernhard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
